gloss: to reduce; to shrink; to scale down

definitions.gloss: to reduce in size; to shrink; to scale down
definitions.explanation: To make something smaller in scale, scope, or size, or for something to become smaller on its own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}する。
examples.english: To reduce the size of an image.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}することになった。
examples.english: It was decided to scale down the business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}し⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The market continues to shrink due to the declining birth rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦コロナ→コロナ：28801_korona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}せざる⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the impact of COVID, many companies had no choice but to scale down their operations.

notes:
The opposite of ⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to expand). Used for both physical reduction (images, maps) and abstract reduction (business, scope). Can be transitive (someone shrinks something) or intransitive (something shrinks on its own).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縮小|しゅくしょう}する: to scale down the size
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧: business downsizing
- ⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: shrinking trend
- ⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧⟦{均衡|きんこう}→均衡：05217_kinkou⟧: shrinking equilibrium
- ⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧: enlargement and reduction; zoom in/out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧: to cut, to reduce — focuses on deliberate cutting, often budgets or personnel
- ⟦{減少|げんしょう}する→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧: to decrease — emphasizes numerical decrease
- ⟦{圧縮|あっしゅく}→圧縮：04884_asshuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compress — implies physical compression or shortening of time/data
